dict.string: LidGuard needs camera access to capture a photo when your Mac wakes from sleep or the lid is opened, helping you identify unauthorized access.
LidGuard uses your location to tag security alert photos with precise GPS coordinates, helping you locate your Mac if accessed by an unauthorized person.
